name: astronomy-mcp-server
description: What's in the sky, computed offline — planet and moon positions, rise/set, phases, eclipses, and seasons for any place and time.

interface.shortDescription: What's in the sky, computed offline — positions, rise/set, phases, eclipses, and seasons.
interface.longDescription: Observational astronomy computed in-process via astronomy-engine — apparent positions of the Sun, Moon, and planets; rise, set, and culmination times with twilight; moon phase and illumination; eclipses; equinoxes and solstices; oppositions, conjunctions, elongations, and apsides; and a one-call 'what's up tonight' list. Keyless, offline, and deterministic for any observer location and time. Optional gated extensions add JPL Horizons small-body ephemerides and CelesTrak satellite passes.
